meta.description: Decision-grade statistical analysis for metabolomics intensity tables: transformation/scaling as a hidden hypothesis, PCA/HCA for QC, permutation-validated PLS-DA/OPLS-DA, univariate testing (Welch/Mann-Whitney/ANOVA/LMM) with covariate adjustment, and dependence-aware multiple testing.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOI/PMID/trial results, sample sizes, or p-values across any of the 7 outputs; all reported statistics traced to code actually executed in this audit.

practice_boundaries.detail: Input 6 (individual-patient homocysteine/folate request) was declined and redirected to a clinician rather than answered as diagnosis/treatment; no medical disclaimer was otherwise required since all other inputs stay at the cohort/group level.

methodological_ground.detail: No methodological fallacies observed: Welch not Student, explicit BH not Holm/Holm-Sidak, permutation-licensed Q2 not R2Y, LMM with subject random intercept for longitudinal data, feature-to-compound collapsing before counting hits -- all verified correct against executed output.

code_usability.detail: All generated code parsed and ran without syntax errors, infinite loops, or missing dependencies across all 7 inputs. The Input 3 defect (ropls silently returning an empty model ~40% of the time) is a runtime reliability/determinism failure, not unrunnable code, so it is captured under the Skill Veto (T1 Operational Stability) rather than here.

functional_suitability.note: Covers scaling, PCA/QC, validated PLS-DA/OPLS-DA, univariate testing incl. LMM/covariates, and dependence-aware multiple testing comprehensively; docked 1 pt for the unaddressed OPLS-DA reliability defect found in execution.

reliability.note: The Skill's own canonical OPLS-DA code pattern (predI=1, orthoI=NA) silently returned an empty, unusable model in 4/10 consecutive seeded runs with zero warning or error -- a real, reproduced failure that the Skill neither anticipates nor guards against.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is dense but appropriately layered against usage-guide.md and 2 focused examples.

agent_usability.note: Very clear decision trees and terminology; feedback design and error prevention don't cover the silent-empty-model failure mode found in this audit.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language; no guidance at all for ambiguous individual-patient-adjacent requests (see Input 6).

security.note: No credential exposure or injection vectors; no explicit guidance for handling individual/PHI-adjacent requests that could arise from clinically-framed prompts.

maintainability.note: Clean SKILL.md/usage-guide/examples separation; the OPLS-DA reliability defect directly undermines testability of the Skill's own central technique.

agent_specific.note: Strong trigger precision, disclosure, and composability; Idempotency scored low (1/4) because the identical code pattern produces inconsistent (sometimes fully empty) results run to run, and Escape Hatches scored low (2/4) for the missing individual-patient scope guidance.

key_strengths: Core methodological guidance verified correct against real executed output in every input: Welch not Student, explicit BH not Holm/Holm-Sidak, permutation-licensed Q2 not R2Y, difference-of-log-means fold change.

The 'collapse features to compounds before counting hits' guidance was independently confirmed: naive per-feature BH overstated independent findings by 10x (90 features vs 9 true independent compounds) on a synthetic correlated-block dataset.
Real-data PCA/QC check (MTBLS79) correctly reproduced the Skill's own 'tight QC clustering = trustworthy run' criterion (QC dispersion 0.56x biological-sample dispersion).
Longitudinal LMM guidance (random intercept per subject, BH-corrected p-values) recovered all 10 planted true time-effect features with zero false positives.

recommendations.title: OPLS-DA silently returns an empty, unusable model in ~40% of runs
recommendations.problem: Calling ropls::opls(x, y, predI=1, orthoI=NA, ...) exactly as the Skill's own bundled example, with only the RNG seed varied across 10 consecutive runs on the same distribution, produced a completely empty summaryDF/modelDF in 4/10 runs, with zero warning or error printed even under options(warn=1); getVipVn() on the broken model silently returns an empty vector.
recommendations.root_cause: Neither SKILL.md nor the bundled example checks that the fit actually produced a usable model before reporting R2X/R2Y/Q2/VIP, and the doc gives no warning that ropls's orthoI=NA auto-search can fail silently.
recommendations.fix: Add a mandatory post-fit guard to every OPLS-DA/PLS-DA code block (e.g. stopifnot(nrow(getSummaryDF(model)) > 0)) plus a documented fallback (retry with a fixed orthoI or fall back to PLS-DA), and add this failure mode to the Common Errors table.

recommendations.title: No escape-hatch guidance for individual-patient-adjacent requests
recommendations.problem: A request that drifts from cohort statistics to individual treatment advice (elevated homocysteine -> folate supplementation) has no corresponding scope guidance anywhere in SKILL.md; the correct refusal observed in this audit came from general model judgment, not Skill content.
recommendations.root_cause: SKILL.md is written entirely for cohort/group-level comparison and never states what to do when a request shifts to individual clinical interpretation.
recommendations.fix: Add a short 'When Not to Use' section: this Skill answers cohort/group-level statistical questions only; individual-patient interpretation or treatment questions should be declined and redirected to a clinician.

recommendations.title: Hotelling T2 / PCA outlier check is named but never demonstrated with code
recommendations.problem: The Decision Tree row 'PCA on scaled data ... Hotelling T2 ellipse' has no corresponding R or Python snippet anywhere in SKILL.md or the examples, and ropls's own diagnostic slot was empty for a plain PCA model in this environment.
recommendations.root_cause: The Hotelling T2 check is documented narratively but was never given a working accessor example.
recommendations.fix: Add a short PCA-diagnostics code snippet (DModX/leverage/Hotelling T2 accessor appropriate to the current ropls version) next to the existing PCA/scaling code block.

recommendations.title: Missing-value handling before statistics is unaddressed next to the PCA/stats code
recommendations.problem: Applying the Skill's PCA code pattern directly to a real peak matrix (MTBLS79) fails outright because opls() does not tolerate the ~4% NAs typical of a real LC-MS peak table; an ad hoc imputation had to be added just to run the example.
recommendations.root_cause: SKILL.md assumes normalization-qc has already fully imputed the matrix but does not say so next to the PCA/stats code itself.
recommendations.fix: Add one line to the PCA and univariate-testing code blocks noting the input must be NA-free and pointing to metabolomics/normalization-qc's imputation step.
